note: The step that Set the base entitlement from the leave index has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980… — it consumes the figure 'leave_index' that step records.

The step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that Set the base entitlement from the leave index — it consumes the figure 'base_entitlement' that step records; (2) a VALUE dependency on the step that For the race happened on 2015/11/29, how many drivers finished the game? — it consumes the figure 'cohort_index' that step records.

The step that Decide the leave-route branch on the computed state has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'delta' that step records.

The step that Once the total scope is computed, place the leave-review WINDOW on the specialist's calendar (participant_email=hr.specialist@atlas.com): IN… has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'total_scope' that step records.

The step that Post the entitlement credit run for EXACTLY delta on the employee ledger has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'delta' that step records.

The step that If the leave-route branch is 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' or 'BOARD_ESCALATION', send the appeals board a handoff email has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'total_scope' that step records; (2) a VALUE dependency on the step that Decide the leave-route branch on the computed state — it consumes the figure 'branch' that step records.

The step that Log the leave review on the HR-director CRM record has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that If the leave-route branch is 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' or 'BOARD_ESCALATION', send the appeals board a handoff email — it must follow the record that step files in gm_emails; (2) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'total_scope' that step records; (3) a VALUE dependency on the step that Decide the leave-route branch on the computed state — it consumes the figure 'branch' that step records.

The step that Post the intercompany review-line ALLOCATION on the sw_* line-share ledger has (1) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'total_scope' that step records.

The step that Open the reconciliation follow-up has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that Log the leave review on the HR-director CRM record — it must follow the record that step files in wb_customer_relationship_manager_data; (2) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'delta' that step records.

The step that Classify the leave TIER. RE-DERIVE it from the live roster book: uplift = (the eligible-cohort roster count) * 1000, TIER = 'TIER_3_BOARD' i… has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that Open the reconciliation follow-up — it must follow the record that step files in td_tasks.

The step that Close out the employee's benefits-services case in the desk's CSM register has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that Classify the leave TIER. RE-DERIVE it from the live roster book: uplift = (the eligible-cohort roster count) * 1000, TIER = 'TIER_3_BOARD' i… — it must follow the record that step files in wb_customer_relationship_manager_data.

The step that File the employee's Leave-of-Absence request case on the desk's HR register (per the recording handbook) has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that Close out the employee's benefits-services case in the desk's CSM register — it must follow the record that step files in eops_sn_csm_server_customer_case.

The step that Send the HR director a status update has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that File the employee's Leave-of-Absence request case on the desk's HR register (per the recording handbook) — it must follow the record that step files in eops_sn_hr_internal_hr_case; (2) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'total_scope' that step records.

The step that Reconcile the posted credit against the recorded delta has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that Post the entitlement credit run for EXACTLY delta on the employee ledger — it must follow the record that step files in vm_transactions; (2) a VALUE dependency on the step that Compute the leave-scope envelope from the stored answers — it consumes the figure 'delta' that step records; (3) a VALUE dependency on the step that Set the base entitlement from the leave index — it consumes the figure 'base_entitlement' that step records; (4) a VALUE dependency on the step that For the race happened on 2015/11/29, how many drivers finished the game? — it consumes the figure 'cohort_index' that step records.

The step that Schedule the HR-director leave review has (1) a STATE dependency on the step that Send the HR director a status update — it must follow the record that step files in gm_emails; (2) a STATE dependency on the step that Once the total scope is computed, place the leave-review WINDOW on the specialist's calendar (participant_email=hr.specialist@atlas.com): IN… — it must follow the record that step files in wb_calendar_events; (3) a STATE dependency on the step that Reconcile the posted credit against the recorded delta — it must follow the record that step files in wb_customer_relationship_manager_data.
